request.style: English, jazz, female solo voice with warm tone, brushed snare, upright bass, piano, saxophone, muted trumpet, smoky intimate mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I hold my lot secure in your hand
My portion is your grace, my cup filled
The boundary lines fell in pleasant places
A beautiful inheritance, so true

[Chorus]
I have set the Lord always before me
He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken

[Verse]
I bless the Lord who counsels my soul
At night my inmost being is instructed
My heart is glad and my glory rejoices
My body rests secure in your keeping

[Chorus]
I have set the Lord always before me
He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken

[Bridge]
You will not abandon my soul to the grave
Nor let your faithful one see decay
You make known to me the path of life
In your presence there is fullness of joy

[Chorus]
I have set the Lord always before me
He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken

[Outro]
At your right hand are pleasures forevermore
The Lord is my portion and my cup
